# Files generated by Tack

- Text between `<!-- BEGIN:tack` and `<!-- END:tack -->`, and files whose first line says they are generated by Tack, are outputs. Do not edit them. Edit the source they name, then run `npx tack sync`.
- Links in `.claude/skills/`, `.claude/agents/`, `.claude/rules/` and `.agents/skills/` point at their sources. Editing through a link edits the source. For a personal harness, save with `npx tack personal save -m "<message>"`.
- Run `npx tack why <unit ID>` to see where a rule comes from before changing or overriding it.
